# If no antimicrobial prophylaxis recommended, select appropriate order below:

Select here No antimicrobial prophylaxis recommended for procedure/surgery

Select here No antimicrobial prophylaxis, already on concurrent antimicrobials

References

- Bratzler DW, et al.  Clinical practice guidelines for antimicrobial prophylaxis in surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm. 2013 Vol 70 page 195-283
- Antimicrobial Prophylaxis for Surgery, Treatment Guidelines from The Medical
- Letter 2012 Vol 10 pages 73-77
Therapy:
## Preferred:

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

## Alternative for patients with beta lactam allergy:

Clindamycin 900 mg IV over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes before incision

($$) [H,O]

## Known MRSA colonization:

[Vancomycin 15 MG/KG IV beginning 120 minutes before incision \($\) R](surg-vancomycin-weight-based-dosing)
